what: Bare validator exit violates the publish KV contract
scenario_or_breakage: Plan adds larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || exit $?; an out-of-allowlist path exits 2 without PUBLISH_OK=false even though validation failures are documented as parseable PUBLISH_OK=false outcomes
suggested_fix: Use larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || { emit_publish_result false; exit 0; } after emit_publish_result is defined

what: Bare validator exit bypasses PAUSE_OK parsing
scenario_or_breakage: /larch:pause captures design-pause-save.sh under set -e and then parses PAUSE_OK; exit 2 aborts before pause-save.out is written or PAUSE_OK=false ERROR=... is parsed
suggested_fix: Use larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || emit_fail "tmpdir-invalid" after the existing required-arg and directory checks

what: Validator rc 2 is misclassified as a plan-artifact failure
scenario_or_breakage: check-plan-size.sh reserves rc 3 for argv errors and rc 2 for missing or malformed plan artifacts with PLAN_SIZE_STATUS; bare validator failure returns rc 2 with no PLAN_SIZE_STATUS, sending Step 2b.5 down the wrong branch
suggested_fix: Use larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || exit 3 so validation remains a stderr-only argv error

what: Bare validator exit breaks exit-0 preview degradation
scenario_or_breakage: step3 and gatec currently print a user-facing missing/invalid DESIGN_TMPDIR warning and exit 0; validating before the variant case exits 2 instead and can abort a display-only preview path
suggested_fix: Move validation into each variant after the existing -d check and route validator failure to the same variant warning plus exit 0

what: Bare validator exit bypasses FINALIZE_PLAN_STATUS for invalid tmpdirs
scenario_or_breakage: finalize-plan.sh reports design-tmpdir and artifact failures through FINALIZE_PLAN_STATUS; inserting bare exit before the existing ! -d check makes out-of-allowlist tmpdirs fail with no status key
suggested_fix: Use larch_design_tmpdir_validate "$DESIGN_TMPDIR" || { emit_kv FINALIZE_PLAN_STATUS missing-design-tmpdir; exit 1; } or document and test a new invalid-design-tmpdir status
